May 8, 1974
In accordance with current agreements between NIPC and NIRPC, we have reviewed the following summary of Federal Grant Application:
NIPC #74-228 Illinois Dept. of Transportation - Funding for improvements to FAP Route #23 Lincoln Highway from Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road.
We concur that this project does require submission to the Interstate Planning Committee for their review as prescribed in Section III, Paragraph D, Items 1 and 2, of current agreement.
Very truly yours,
